newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Norwood, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Norwood, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Borough Council at 455 Broadway, Norwood, N.J. on
until 8:00 p.m., for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Borough dated August 1, 1997 and due (without option of prior redemption) on August 1st as follows:

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Borough in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Borough will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, L.L.C., Newark, N.J.

The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on February 1st and August 1st in each year until maturity, commencing on February 1, 1998. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Nicholas Goldsack, the Chief Financial Officer, at 455 Broadway, Norwood, N.J. 07648, (201) 767-7200.
